            ; ---- the handler -------------------------------------------
            ; Entered from CINV with A, X, Y pushed and the KERNAL's bank
            ; frame under them (kernal/drivers/x16/memory.s __irq).
        cx16rl_irq:
            lda $9F27
            and #$02
            bne cx16rl_line
            jmp ($0405)
        cx16rl_line:
            lda #$02
            sta $9F27
            lda $9F25
            pha
            lda #0
            sta $9F25
            ldx $0401
        cx16rl_entry:
            ; layer writes: from two scanlines on, whole
            lda $04C0,x
            and #$04
            beq cx16rl_noscroll
            lda $0540,x
            sta $9F37
            lda $0560,x
            sta $9F38
        cx16rl_noscroll:
            lda $04C0,x
            and #$08
            beq cx16rl_nochar
            lda $0580,x
            sta $9F36
        cx16rl_nochar:
            lda $04C0,x
            and #$03
            beq cx16rl_next
            ; composer writes: in the horizontal blank of the next scanline
            lda $9F20
            pha
            lda $9F21
            pha
            lda $9F22
            pha
            lda $0403
            sta $9F20
            lda #$FA
            sta $9F21
            lda #$11
            sta $9F22
            lda $9F28
        cx16rl_edge:
            cmp $9F28
            beq cx16rl_edge
            ldy #40
        cx16rl_delay:
            dey
            bne cx16rl_delay
            lda $04C0,x
            and #$01
            beq cx16rl_keep
            lda $04E0,x
            sta $9F2C
            jmp cx16rl_palette
        cx16rl_keep:
            lda $9F2C
            sta $9F2C
        cx16rl_palette:
            lda $04C0,x
            and #$02
            beq cx16rl_restore
            lda $0500,x
            sta $9F23
            lda $0520,x
            sta $9F23
        cx16rl_restore:
            pla
            sta $9F22
            pla
            sta $9F21
            pla
            sta $9F20
        cx16rl_next:
            inx
            cpx $0402
            bcc cx16rl_arm
            ; the pass is over: one more video frame, then the first planned line, next frame
            inc $0408
            ldx #0
            lda $0480
            sta $9F28
            lda $04A0
            ora #$02
            sta $9F26
            jmp cx16rl_out
        cx16rl_arm:
            lda $0480,x
            sta $9F28
            lda $04A0,x
            ora #$02
            sta $9F26
            ; already there? (two planned lines closer than the handler)
            lda $9F26
            and #$40
            asl a
            cmp $04A0,x
            bcc cx16rl_out
            bne cx16rl_late
            lda $9F28
            cmp $0480,x
            bcc cx16rl_out
        cx16rl_late:
            lda #$02
            sta $9F27
            jmp cx16rl_entry
        cx16rl_out:
            stx $0401
            pla
            sta $9F25
            pla
            tay
            pla
            tax
            pla
            rti

        cx16rl_installed:
